name: eventify-monorepo
description: Eventify - Full-Stack Event Booking Platform (PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Express.js, React)

scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run db:push --prefix backend
